name: Segue Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Segue Group Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, provides design, development, sales, construction, operation, and maintenance services related to IT infrastructure and network security products in Japan and Thailand. The company offers firewall/VPN, UTM, web application firewall, malware countermeasures, security vulnerability diagnosis and management, IP address management, network management, cyberattack detection and analysis, and network authentication appliances, as well as wireless LAN, routers, LAN switches, servers, and storages, and others.
